title: clerodendrum schweinfurthii var. longituba
intro: Clerodendrum schweinfurthii var. longituba, commonly known as the Ivory Coast Glory Bower, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum schweinfurthii var. longituba include wound healing, antimalarial, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
